nodes.name: LocalHeatSource.cs
nodes.summary: Localized heat source component implementing IHeatSource. Uses a Collider2D trigger to register/unregister itself with overlapping HeatSensitive components, exposing a settable Temperature that re-registers the source with nearby heat sensitives.
nodes.languageNotes: [SerializeField] inspector collider, Overlap() with ContactFilter2D, TryGetComponent pattern, OnTriggerEnter2D/OnTriggerExit2D lifecycle.

nodes.name: LocalHeatSource
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour heat emitter that adds itself as an IHeatSource to every HeatSensitive whose collider overlaps _heatCollider, whenever enabled or when its Temperature changes. Re-registers on enable and unregisters on disable.

nodes.name: Temperature
nodes.summary: IHeatSource.Temperature property; setting a new value re-runs overlap detection so heat sensitives in range receive this source.

nodes.name: AddSourceToOverlappedHeatSensitives
nodes.summary: Overlaps _heatCollider and calls AddHeatSource(this) on every HeatSensitive component found.

nodes.name: RemoveSourceFromOverlappedHeatSensitives
nodes.summary: Overlaps _heatCollider and calls RemoveHeatSource(this) on every HeatSensitive component found, used on disable.

nodes.name: Magnetosphere.cs
nodes.summary: Player magnet for magnetic LooseItems: items in a magnet range are pulled toward the player with an inverse-square force and collected into the Inventory when they intersect a collect collider.
nodes.languageNotes: FixedUpdate physics loop, Rigidbody2D.AddForce Impulse, list mutation deferred past loop to avoid modifying during iteration, collider-bounds intersection checks.

nodes.name: Magnetosphere
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that tracks LooseItems in a magnet collider, applies inverse-square magnetic force toward the player, and collects any magnetic item whose bounds intersect a separate collect collider into the Inventory.

nodes.name: FixedUpdate
nodes.summary: Main loop: for each magnetic loose item in range with inventory space, apply magnetic force and collect; destroys collected items after the loop.

nodes.name: CollectItem
nodes.summary: Returns true and adds the item to the inventory if the loose item bounds intersect the collect collider and TryAddItem succeeds.

nodes.name: ApplyMagneticForce
nodes.summary: Pulls a loose item toward the player via an inverse-square Coulomb-style force (strength / radius^2) applied as an impulse on its Rigidbody2D.

nodes.name: MatchLightWithSun.cs
nodes.summary: Small component that mirrors the global SunLightControl's current intensity and color onto a local Light2D every LateUpdate, so interior lights track the sun.
nodes.languageNotes: URP Light2D, tag-based lookup of a Sun object, LateUpdate read of SunLightControl properties.

nodes.name: MatchLightWithSun
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that finds the tagged Sun GameObject in Awake and copies its SunLightControl intensity and color onto this object's Light2D each frame.

nodes.name: LateUpdate
nodes.summary: Assigns _light.intensity and _light.color from _sun.Intensity and _sun.LightColor when a sun is present.

nodes.name: Narrator.cs
nodes.summary: Scene-level singleton that queues and displays short narrative messages as pixel-text overlays, running on unscaled time so narration continues during pause. Also prints first-visit scene messages on entering a scene for the first time.
nodes.languageNotes: static Instance accessor, Queue<string> + unscaledDeltaTime timing, coroutine with WaitForSecondsRealtime, GameObject tag lookup, instantiates PixelCanvasTextRenderer message prefabs.

nodes.name: Narrator
nodes.summary: Queues narrative messages, prints them as stacked pixel-text overlays, fades and destroys them after a lifespan, and exposes AreMessagesClear for other systems to await message drain.

nodes.name: Instance
nodes.summary: Static singleton accessor; logs an error if the Narrator is not present in the scene.

nodes.name: PostMessage
nodes.summary: Public API that enqueues a string to be displayed once the post-message delay elapses.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Checks message life spans, then dequeues and prints the next queued message once the post-message buffer exceeds the delay (unscaled time).

nodes.name: PrintMessage
nodes.summary: Shifts existing messages up, instantiates the message prefab into the container, sets its Text via PixelCanvasTextRenderer, and records its start time.

nodes.name: CheckMessageLifeSpans
nodes.summary: Fades out messages older than _messageDurationSecs and destroys them once alpha falls below the fade rate.

nodes.name: AreMessagesClear
nodes.summary: Returns true when no posted messages remain and the queue is empty; used by sleep and other sequences to wait for narration to drain.

nodes.name: PrintFirstVisitToSceneMessage
nodes.summary: On a first visit (SceneSaveLoadManager.IsFirstVisit) schedules scene-specific ambient messages, e.g. 'i need to find shelter' on first entering Outside.

nodes.name: PostMessageAfterDelay
nodes.summary: Coroutine that waits in real time, then posts the message via the Narrator or via PlayerDialogue depending on the narrator flag.

nodes.name: ObjectPooling.cs
nodes.summary: Simple static GameObject object pool. SpawnObject reuses an inactive pooled instance or instantiates a new one; ReturnObjectToPool deactivates and stores objects under their pool key.
nodes.languageNotes: static class members on a MonoBehaviour, nested PooledObjectInfo data holder, NUnit Assert.IsNotNull guard, Logger usage, FirstOrDefault LINQ lookup.

nodes.name: ObjectPooling
nodes.summary: Static object pool service: SpawnObject pulls from a per-prefab inactive list or instantiates under a shared container; ReturnObjectToPool matches by stripped '(Clone)' name.

nodes.name: PooledObjectInfo
nodes.summary: Nested data holder tracking a prefab's LookupString and its list of inactive pooled GameObjects.

nodes.name: SpawnObject
nodes.summary: Static factory: finds the pool for a prefab, reuses the first inactive instance (repositioning/re-rotating it) or instantiates a new one under the pool container, then returns it active.

nodes.name: ReturnObjectToPool
nodes.summary: Static method that strips the '(Clone)' suffix, finds the matching pool, and stores the object deactivated; warns if no pool matches.

nodes.name: OccupyWorldObjectSpace.cs
nodes.summary: Marks a world object as occupying a rectangular tile footprint (configured by extra-tile fields) on the scene's WorldObjectOccupancyMap while enabled, and frees that space on disable.
nodes.languageNotes: public int footprint fields read by SceneSpawner, Action-based removal handle returned by SetOccupied, OnEnable/OnDisable pairing, tag lookup for the occupancy map.

nodes.name: OccupyWorldObjectSpace
nodes.summary: Registers the object's tile footprint (center plus extra tiles left/right/above/below) with the scene occupancy map on enable and releases it on disable.

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Locates the Impermanent container's WorldObjectOccupancyMap and calls SetOccupied with the object's footprint, storing the returned removal Action.

nodes.name: OutsideTemperature.cs
nodes.summary: Singleton IHeatSource representing outdoor ambient temperature, backed by WorldState.OutsideTemperature. On temperature change or scene load it re-registers itself with all HeatSensitive components on the player and under the scene Grid.
nodes.languageNotes: singleton destroy-pattern, IHeatSource implementation, recursive child traversal for HeatSensitive registration, SceneManager.sceneLoaded subscription, Logger usage.

nodes.name: OutsideTemperature
nodes.summary: Scene-independent ambient temperature source; its Temperature property writes through to WorldState.OutsideTemperature and fans out to every HeatSensitive in the scene (player plus world-grid children).

nodes.name: Temperature
nodes.summary: IHeatSource.Temperature property backed by WorldState.OutsideTemperature; on change logs and triggers re-registration with all heat sensitives.

nodes.name: OnTemperatureChange
nodes.summary: Re-adds this source to all heat sensitives under the scene grid when the outside temperature changes.

nodes.name: AddToAllHeatSensitives
nodes.summary: Adds this source to the player's PlayerTemperatureManager and recurses through the world grid's children.

nodes.name: AddToAllChildHeatSensitives
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a transform's descendants and calls AddHeatSource on each HeatSensitive component found.

nodes.name: OnSceneLoaded
nodes.summary: On scene load, caches the Player's PlayerTemperatureManager and the scene Grid, then registers this source with all heat sensitives.

nodes.name: Persistence.cs
nodes.summary: Static JSON persistence helper (namespace ColePersistence) that serializes/deserializes objects with Newtonsoft.Json into Application.persistentDataPath, with exists and delete helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: static class in ColePersistence namespace, Newtonsoft JsonConvert, Path.Combine with Application.persistentDataPath, synchronous File I/O.

nodes.name: JsonPersistence
nodes.summary: Static utility for persisting arbitrary objects as JSON under a relative path inside Application.persistentDataPath; the low-level store used by the save system.

nodes.name: GetPersistencePath
nodes.summary: Combines a relative path with Application.persistentDataPath.

nodes.name: PersistJson
nodes.summary: Serializes an object to JSON and writes it to the persisted path.

nodes.name: FromJson
nodes.summary: Reads a JSON file from the persisted path and deserializes it into type T.

nodes.name: JsonExists
nodes.summary: Returns whether a save file exists at the given relative path.

nodes.name: DeleteFile
nodes.summary: Deletes the persisted file at the given relative path if it exists.

nodes.name: PickUpOnInteract.cs
nodes.summary: Interactable pickup: on cursor interaction adds a fixed item quantity to the player's inventory, plays a pickup sound, and destroys the object, or posts a no-space message.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements InteractInput.IInteractable.CursorInteract, [SerializeField] Inventory.Item + SoundData, static AudioManager.PlaySFX, PlayerDialogue.Instance.PostMessage.

nodes.name: PickUpOnInteract
nodes.summary: Adds a configured item to the player inventory on cursor interact; if space is insufficient it posts a no-space message through PlayerDialogue.

nodes.name: CursorInteract
nodes.summary: Tries to add the item to inventory; on success plays the pickup sound and destroys the object, otherwise posts a dialogue message. Always returns true.

nodes.name: ReduceOpacityWhenPlayerBehind.cs
nodes.summary: Fades a visual (SpriteRenderer, Image, CanvasGroup, or a SortingGroup's child sprites) to a lower opacity while the player's collider overlaps, and restores it on exit.
nodes.languageNotes: coroutine-based lerp fade, supports multiple opacity-bearing components via conditional branches, tooltip-serialized options (_targetParent), Debug.Log noise on trigger enter.

nodes.name: ReduceOpacityWhenPlayerBehind
nodes.summary: Detects the player overlapping its trigger, then fades the configured opacity component (optionally on the parent) down and back, using a cancellable fade coroutine.

nodes.name: OnTriggerEnter2D
nodes.summary: Starts a fade to _fadedOpacity when a player-rooted object enters the trigger.

nodes.name: OnTriggerExit2D
nodes.summary: Starts a fade back to the original alpha when the player leaves the trigger.

nodes.name: FadeToOpacity
nodes.summary: Coroutine that lerps the target opacity component(s) - SpriteRenderer, Image, CanvasGroup, or all SortingGroup child sprites - toward a target alpha over _fadeDuration.

nodes.name: SaveData.cs
nodes.summary: Serializable per-world-object save payload: identifier, persistent ID, position (via SimpleVector3), and extended JSON data. Defines the ISaveable component contract and instantiates prefabs back from Resources on load.
nodes.languageNotes: Newtonsoft serializable plain class, nested ISaveable interface + SimpleVector3 value holder (Vector3 is not JSON-friendly), Resources.Load prefab lookup under 'WorldObjects/'.

nodes.name: SaveData
nodes.summary: Plain serializable payload describing a saved world object: Identifier (prefab key under Resources/WorldObjects), PersistentID, Position, and ExtendedData JSON for component-specific state.

nodes.name: ISaveable
nodes.summary: Nested interface that world-object components implement to capture their own SaveData (Save()) and restore it (Load).

nodes.name: SimpleVector3
nodes.summary: Nested float-triplet value holder used instead of Vector3 because Unity's Vector3 does not JSON-serialize cleanly.

nodes.name: AddIdentifier
nodes.summary: Validates that a prefab exists at Resources/WorldObjects/<identifier> and stores the identifier; logs an error and returns false otherwise.

nodes.name: AddTransformPosition
nodes.summary: Stores a Vector3 position as a SimpleVector3 for serialization.

nodes.name: AddExtendedSaveData
nodes.summary: Serializes arbitrary component state to the ExtendedData JSON string, returning false and logging on failure.

nodes.name: GetExtendedSaveData
nodes.summary: Deserializes ExtendedData back into type T, returning default(T) on failure.

nodes.name: InstantiateGameObjectFromSaveData
nodes.summary: Loads the prefab from Resources/WorldObjects/<Identifier> and instantiates it under the given parent at the saved position.

nodes.name: SceneSaveLoadManager.cs
nodes.summary: Central save/load manager: persists each scene's world objects (children of the Impermanent container) to a per-scene JSON file, persists global player-component state, replays elapsed game-time ticks on load, and manages the first-visit flag.
nodes.languageNotes: [DefaultExecutionOrder(100)], static IsFirstVisit flag, JsonPersistence (ColePersistence), GameObject tag lookup, ISaveableComponent discovery via FindObjectsByType, Dictionary per-component JSON states.

nodes.name: SceneSaveLoadManager
nodes.summary: Saves/loads world objects under the Impermanent container per scene, saves/restores ISaveableComponent state globally across scenes, and replays GameClock ticks to simulate elapsed time away from a scene.

nodes.name: SceneSaveData
nodes.summary: Nested per-scene payload holding a list of world-object SaveData plus the game time when the player exited the scene.

nodes.name: PlayerComponentsSaveData
nodes.summary: Nested payload mapping each ISaveableComponent's ComponentId to its captured JSON state.

nodes.name: IsFirstVisit
nodes.summary: Static lazy flag: true when no per-scene save file exists yet for the current scene; errors if no manager is in the scene.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Sets the static instance, resets the first-visit flag, loads the current scene save, and subscribes to sceneLoaded.

nodes.name: OnSceneLoaded
nodes.summary: Resets cached containers and the first-visit flag, then reloads the newly active scene's save.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Restores global player component state from the PlayerComponents save file after the scene is up.

nodes.name: OnApplicationQuit
nodes.summary: Persists player component state when the app quits.

nodes.name: SaveScene
nodes.summary: Public API that gathers child SaveData from the Impermanent container, records the current game time, and persists the scene to its JSON file.

nodes.name: LoadScene
nodes.summary: Reads the scene save file; if present, destroys existing container children, instantiates saved objects, and replays elapsed game minutes on ITickable children.

nodes.name: SavePlayerComponents
nodes.summary: Static: captures state from every ISaveableComponent in the scene into a ComponentId-to-JSON dictionary and persists it to PlayerComponents.json.

nodes.name: LoadPlayerComponents
nodes.summary: Restores each ISaveableComponent's state from the PlayerComponents save, skipping missing entries and swallowing per-component failures.

nodes.name: FindAllSaveableComponents
nodes.summary: Scans all MonoBehaviours in the scene and collects those implementing ISaveableComponent.

nodes.name: GatherChildSaveData
nodes.summary: Walks the container's children, letting SaveData.ISaveable components produce their own SaveData, or synthesizing identifier+position SaveData from the GameObject name.

nodes.name: InstantiateAndLoadSavedObjects
nodes.summary: Instantiates each SaveData's GameObject and calls Load on any SaveData.ISaveable component found on it.

nodes.name: ProcessElaspedTimeForChildren
nodes.summary: Computes elapsed game minutes since the recorded scene exit time and ticks each GameClock.ITickable child once per minute to simulate time passing while away.

nodes.name: ClearTWNSaves
nodes.summary: Static: deletes saved-data files for The Way North scenes (numeric suffix) whose base scene name is in the given set, used when regenerating the TWN network.

nodes.name: SceneSpawner.cs
nodes.summary: Tilemap-driven world object spawner. Reads marker tiles and SpawnObjectInfo configs, filters candidate positions by occupancy, object footprint size, Perlin noise, and near-type proximity, then instantiates prefab variants on first visit only.
nodes.languageNotes: heavy Logger.Info/Verbose instrumentation, tile-position filtering pipeline, static overloaded CalculateWorldPosition, SpawnOffset lookup, Fisher-Yates Shuffle<T>.

nodes.name: SceneSpawner
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour placed on a marker tilemap that spawns configured prefab variants onto world tilemaps during a scene's first visit, respecting occupancy, footprint size, noise, and adjacency constraints.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Spawns objects if this is the scene's first visit, otherwise deactivates the spawner GameObject.

nodes.name: InitializeSpawner
nodes.summary: Caches the marker Tilemap, all world tilemaps under the Tilemaps tag, the Impermanent container and occupancy map, logs tile/marker diagnostics, and verifies prefab variants share a footprint.

nodes.name: SpawnObjects
nodes.summary: For each SpawnObjectInfo config: computes valid tile positions, filters by occupancy/size/noise/nearby-types, shuffles, instantiates the chosen variant count, and removes newly-occupied positions.

nodes.name: ApplyPerlinNoiseToPositions
nodes.summary: Keeps only positions whose Perlin-noise value exceeds the config's threshold, producing natural clustering.

nodes.name: RemovePositionsOccupiedByNewObject
nodes.summary: Removes positions within a just-spawned object's footprint so objects don't overlap one another.

nodes.name: RemovePositionsThatAreOccupied
nodes.summary: Filters out positions already marked occupied on the WorldObjectOccupancyMap.

nodes.name: RemovePositionsThatAreTooSmall
nodes.summary: Keeps only positions where the whole rectangular footprint of the object's OccupyWorldObjectSpace fits within valid tiles.

nodes.name: GetPositionsOfValidTilesInArea
nodes.summary: Collects marker-tile positions that sit on a world tile whose name matches a config's ValidTileTypes (or on no tile when a null entry allows it).

nodes.name: RemovePositionsNotNearTypes
nodes.summary: Keeps only spawn positions within a configurable adjacency distance of a previously spawned or already-existing object of a nearby type.

nodes.name: Shuffle
nodes.summary: Generic Fisher-Yates in-place shuffle of a list, used to randomize spawn order.

nodes.name: VerifyVariantsAreSameSize
nodes.summary: Checks all prefab variants of each config occupy the same tile footprint and logs an error if not.

nodes.name: CalculateWorldPosition
nodes.summary: Static overloads converting a tilemap/grid cell to a world position (cell center +0.5x) and optionally adding a prefab's SpawnOffset.

nodes.name: SelectRandomSprite.cs
nodes.summary: Picks a sprite from a weighted list at Start using the object's world position as a deterministic random seed, so identical objects in different cells get varied but stable sprites.
nodes.languageNotes: nested [System.Serializable] WeightedSprite struct, transform.position.GetHashCode() as seed, System.Random weighted draw.

nodes.name: SelectRandomSprite
nodes.summary: Assigns one of several weighted sprites to the SpriteRenderer at Start, seeded deterministically by world position.

nodes.name: WeightedSprite
nodes.summary: Nested serializable pair of a Sprite and its selection weight.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Computes total weight, seeds a Random by world position, and assigns the selected sprite to the SpriteRenderer.

nodes.name: SleepMenu.cs
nodes.summary: Sleep sequence: pauses the game clock, computes energy recovered from sleep quality and diet, waits for narration to clear, applies recovered energy, skips to the next morning, and re-enters the scene via LevelChanger.
nodes.languageNotes: coroutine-driven sequence with WaitUntil(AreMessagesClear) and WaitForSecondsRealtime, static PlayerSlept event, GameClock pause/skip/resume.

nodes.name: SleepMenu
nodes.summary: Coordinates the end-of-day sleep routine: pauses time, shows recovery messages via the Narrator, recovers energy from sleep and diet, fires PlayerSlept, advances the calendar, and reloads the scene.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Locates PlayerEnergyManager, PlayerTemperatureManager, and PlayerSceneData, then starts the SleepRoutine coroutine.

nodes.name: SleepRoutine
nodes.summary: Pauses the clock, computes and applies sleep+diet energy recovery, posts recovery messages, waits for them to drain, skips to the next day at the wake hour, resumes, and changes scene.

nodes.name: SoundData.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject audio asset describing a clip with volume, looping, pitch/volume variation, fade in/out, and loop-spacing options consumed by the audio managers.
nodes.languageNotes: [CreateAssetMenu] ScriptableObject, [Range] inspector ranges on variation amounts.

nodes.name: SoundData
nodes.summary: Serializable audio configuration asset: clip, volume, looping flag, optional pitch/volume variation, fade in/out with duration, and loop spacing/variation for ambient loops.

nodes.name: SoundDataEditor.cs
nodes.summary: Custom Unity editor inspector for SoundData that conditionally reveals pitch/volume variation fields and looping sub-fields (fade, spacing) with indentation.
nodes.languageNotes: [CustomEditor(typeof(SoundData))], SerializedProperty caching in OnEnable, conditional EditorGUILayout.PropertyField with indent levels.

nodes.name: SoundDataEditor
nodes.summary: Editor drawer for SoundData assets that shows variation options only when enabled and loops-only options only when IsLooping is checked.

nodes.name: OnInspectorGUI
nodes.summary: Renders SoundData fields with conditional visibility for pitch/volume variation and looping sub-options, then applies modified properties.

nodes.name: SpawnItems.cs
nodes.summary: Static helper for spawning loose item pickups: scatters item stacks within a collider or at explicit positions, applies an optional launch velocity/drag direction, and loads items from Resources.
nodes.languageNotes: static class, Resources.Load<Inventory.Item> by ItemLabel, Unity.Mathematics import, switch-expression for launch angle, Rigidbody2D linearDamping/linearVelocity (new 2D API).

nodes.name: SpawnItems
nodes.summary: Static factory that instantiates LooseItem pickups from Inventory.Item data, scattering them inside a collider bounds or at given positions and optionally launching them in a direction.

nodes.name: LaunchDirection
nodes.summary: Nested enum of launch direction options: UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, or ANY.

nodes.name: SpawnItemData
nodes.summary: Nested serializable description of an item type with a min/max quantity range for randomized spawn counts.

nodes.name: SpawnItemsFromCollider
nodes.summary: Overloaded static entry point: spawns a quantity of one item type (or an array of SpawnItemData) at random points inside a collider with a launch direction/speed/drag.

nodes.name: SpawnLooseItems
nodes.summary: Spawns single-quantity loose items at explicit positions, optionally skipping the bounce animation and applying a launch velocity.

nodes.name: FetchItem
nodes.summary: Loads an Inventory.Item from Resources/Items/<itemName>, logging an error if missing.

nodes.name: InstantiateLooseItem
nodes.summary: Instantiates the Resources/Items/LooseItem prefab under the LooseItems container, assigns the item sprite to its SpriteRenderer, and transfers the ItemStack to its LooseItem component.

nodes.name: GetRandomPositionsWithinCollider
nodes.summary: Samples random points inside a collider's bounds until the requested quantity of valid (overlapping) positions are found, capped by attempts.

nodes.name: SetLaunchSpeed
nodes.summary: Sets a spawned object's Rigidbody2D drag and initial velocity from the launch direction and speed.

nodes.name: GenerateLaunchDirection
nodes.summary: Produces a normalized random direction vector constrained to a directional angle window (or full circle for ANY) via a switch expression.

nodes.name: SpawnObjectInfo.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject spawn configuration for SceneSpawner: prefab variants, valid world tile types, density, optional near-type adjacency, and optional Perlin noise gating.
nodes.languageNotes: [CreateAssetMenu] ScriptableObject holding serializable lists of GameObject variants and TileBase types.

nodes.name: SpawnObjectInfo
nodes.summary: Config asset describing how a family of prefab variants should be placed: which tile types they sit on, density fraction, near-type adjacency rules, and Perlin noise parameters.

nodes.name: SpriteLocalCoords.cs
nodes.summary: EditMode component that pushes a sprite's UV-remap vector (from its texture rect and texel size) into the material via MaterialPropertyBlock, or via a material instance in play mode.
nodes.languageNotes: [ExecuteInEditMode], MaterialPropertyBlock or material instance for URP SRP-batcher, _UVRemap vector for a custom shader.

nodes.name: SpriteLocalCoords
nodes.summary: Feeds a sprite's texture-rect UV remap into its material on enable, choosing between a MaterialPropertyBlock (default) or a play-mode-only material instance.

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Computes the uvRemap from sprite texture rect and texel size, then sets it via MaterialPropertyBlock or material instance depending on usePropertyBlock.

nodes.name: SpriteSubdivider.cs
nodes.summary: Subdivides a SpriteRenderer's sprite into a grid of vertices/triangles using OverrideGeometry, optionally on a cloned sprite, to enable per-segment sprite deformation effects.
nodes.languageNotes: Sprite.OverrideGeometry with ushort triangle index buffer, optional Instantiate'd sprite clone with cleanup in OnDestroy.

nodes.name: SpriteSubdivider
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a sprite's mesh as a horizontal-by-vertical grid of triangles on Start (and on demand via Regenerate), cloning the sprite first so the original asset is never mutated.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Runs Regenerate once at start to subdivide the renderer's current sprite.

nodes.name: Regenerate
nodes.summary: Public API that clones the current sprite (if configured) and builds the subdivided geometry on it, recreating the clone if the source sprite changed.

nodes.name: BuildAndOverride
nodes.summary: Generates a grid of vertices and two-triangle quads and applies them to the sprite via OverrideGeometry.

nodes.name: UseItem.cs
nodes.summary: Player item-use driver: queues use input, resolves the target under the grid cursor, and routes item usage through interfaces (IUsableOnWorldObject, IUsableOnTileMap, IUsableWithoutTarget), depleting energy and playing hit sounds on successful use.
nodes.languageNotes: input-queue flag consumed in Update, interface-based extension contracts on Inventory.Item, UnityEngine.Assertions, EventSystem pointer-over guard, PlayerState interruption checks.

nodes.name: UseItemInput
nodes.summary: Drives player item use: queues use-item input, gathers cursor target and interactable tilemap, then tries carried-object placement or inventory-item use against world objects, tilemaps, or with no target.

nodes.name: IUsableOnWorldObject
nodes.summary: Interface implemented by Inventory.Item types that can be used on a world object under the cursor; returns whether the use was consumed.

nodes.name: IUsableOnTileMap
nodes.summary: Interface for items usable on an interactable tilemap layer under the cursor (e.g. Water), returning whether the use was consumed.

nodes.name: IUsableWithoutTarget
nodes.summary: Interface for items usable without any target; returns whether energy was spent.

nodes.name: IUsableWithSound
nodes.summary: Interface for items that play a hit sound after a successful use.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Consumes a queued use: bails if over UI or in a non-interruptible player state, resolves the cursor target and tilemap, then tries carried-object use then inventory-item use.

nodes.name: TryUseCarriedObject
nodes.summary: Places the carried weighty object: adds it to a targeted Box, pushes it onto an IWeightyObjectContainer stack with space, or puts it down at the cursor location.

nodes.name: TryUseInventoryItem
nodes.summary: Gets the active inventory item and its instance data, checks energy sufficiency, then tries use-on-world-object, use-on-tilemap, or use-without-target in order.

nodes.name: TryUseItemOnWorldObject
nodes.summary: If the item implements IUsableOnWorldObject and the target accepts the use, depletes energy and plays the hit sound.

nodes.name: TryUseItemOnTileMap
nodes.summary: If the item implements IUsableOnTileMap and the tilemap use succeeds, depletes energy and plays the hit sound.

nodes.name: TryUseItemWithoutTarget
nodes.summary: If the item implements IUsableWithoutTarget and the targetless use succeeds, depletes energy.

nodes.name: PlayHitSound
nodes.summary: Plays the item's hit sound when it implements IUsableWithSound.

nodes.name: DepleteUseEnergy
nodes.summary: Depletes the item's EnergyCost from the player when the item implements IEnergyDepleting.

nodes.name: VirtualCameraManager.cs
nodes.summary: Cinemachine camera manager that warps the virtual camera to the player's scene spawn position on scene load, skipping the menu scene.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity.Cinemachine CinemachineCamera, OnTargetObjectWarped for hard camera snap, FindFirstObjectByType for PlayerSceneData.

nodes.name: VirtualCameraManager
nodes.summary: On scene load, snaps the CinemachineCamera to the player's recorded spawn position via OnTargetObjectWarped so the camera doesn't fly across the map during transitions.

nodes.name: OnSceneLoaded
nodes.summary: Finds the player and warps the virtual camera target to the player's SceneSpawnPosition, unless loading the GameMenu scene.

nodes.name: WaterLevelEnabler.cs
nodes.summary: Enables the water-body visual group matching the current WorldState.WaterState (flood, full, shallow, puddles, or post-flood) at Start and disables all other groups.
nodes.languageNotes: switch on WorldState.WaterState.Value enum, lists of GameObjects toggled via SetActive.

nodes.name: WaterLevelEnabler
nodes.summary: Switches between pre-configured water-body object groups based on the current water state, enabling exactly one group and disabling the rest at Start.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Disables all water-level groups, then enables the group matching the current WorldState.WaterState.

nodes.name: EnableObjects
nodes.summary: Sets every GameObject in the given list active.

nodes.name: DisableAllObjects
nodes.summary: Deactivates every GameObject in all water-level groups.

nodes.name: WeightyObjectStack.cs
nodes.summary: Weight-capped LIFO stack for carried/stored weighty objects backed by a ReactiveUnity ReactiveStack, with a container interface for world objects that accept pushed weighty objects.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity ReactiveStack<StoredWeightyObject>, UnityEngine.Assertions, plain [System.Serializable] class (not MonoBehaviour), IWeightyObjectContainer extends InteractInput.IInteractable.

nodes.name: WeightyObjectStack
nodes.summary: Reactive LIFO stack of StoredWeightyObjects that tracks cumulative weight against a Capacity, supporting push/pop/peek/clear with weight and space checks.

nodes.name: IWeightyObjectContainer
nodes.summary: Interface for interactable world objects (e.g. crates, wheelbarrows) that expose a WeightyStack for storing carried weighty objects.

nodes.name: Clear
nodes.summary: Empties the stack and resets CurrentWeight to zero.

nodes.name: Push
nodes.summary: Adds a stored object to the top of the stack and adds its weight to CurrentWeight.

nodes.name: Pop
nodes.summary: Removes and returns the top object, subtracting its weight from CurrentWeight.

nodes.name: Peek
